 Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput
 Order on Board
21/07/2023
1)
This is the Second Bail Application filed under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail.
The First Bail Application i.e. MCRC No. 7486/2022 was dismissed on merits vide order dated 13/10/2022.

2) The applicant is arrested on 26/03/2022 in connection with Crime No. 118/2022 registered at Police Station Pusour, District Raigarh (C.G.) for the offence under Sections 376 & 376(2)(e) of Indian Penal Code, Sections 4, 6 & 10 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012 and Section 3(2)(V)(V-A) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 3) Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that when the prosecutrix was pregnant for 7 months then FIR was registered against the applicant by team member of child Line, Raigarh and lodged written complaint stating therein that the applicant took the prosecutrix to the Jungle in between village Tarda and Kathani and built physical relationship for multiple times.
On report being lodged to the above effect, the aforesaid offence has been registered against the present applicant.

4) Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the Manoj Banjara vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63608654/
1 crime in question.

entities.text: Manoj Banjara vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that now the DNA report (Annexure A-3) has come and according to which the applicant is not the biological father of the child born from the victim.
He further submits that there is inordinate delay of about one year in lodging report.

It is submitted further that the applicant is in jail since 26/03/2022, there is no apprehension of the applicant tampering with the evidence or absconding and conclusion of the trial is likely to take some time, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

5) On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application and submits that looking to the statement of prosecutrix, who is aged about 14 years 11 months and the nature of offence, the bail application of the applicant may be rejected.
6) Prosecutrix is present through video conferencing with the aid of Child Help Line, Raigarh alongwith Ms. Gulapi Biswal, who identified her.
The prosecutrix has raised an objection to release of the applicant on bail.
7) I have heard learned Counsel for the parties and perused the case dairy.

8) Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the manner in which the offence is said to have been committed, the gravity of offence, age of prosecutrix, and other material available on record, without commenting anything on merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the application is rejected.
Certified copy as per rules.

-Sd/-
